Source constants and approximation branches are unchanged. Unconsumed APIs, native ABI/mutex/allocator and undefined-input behavior, complete UNO/display formatting, formatter/column auto-input and final CSV integration remain outside the evidence for this module. No alternate calendar selection or unsupported-known-type error is introduced. B8TCAE adds portable actual-owner regression evidence from unchanged ICU78.3 compiled witnesses, retaining pinned source/archive/witness SHA256 values in native-observation fixtures. Public constructor/clone/field/time/limit and original protected-hook callers cover all18 calendar owners; actual RuleBasedTimeZone rule graphs include gap/fold enum options; EraRules uses genuine immutable resources; Calendar factory overloads use real cache/locale/timezone owners. Concrete native-derived cache clients verify reference counts, aliases, cached warnings/errors, eviction and destructor order. Only the host Date clock/default locale/timezone are controlled for reproducible native current-era observations; no core method, allocator, service or registry is replaced. This is bounded test evidence, not full native ABI/thread/allocator/whole-module parity. Runtime code and all broad semantic status fields remain unchanged; unresolved100 coverage gaps remain explicit. B8TCAE adds128 independently compiled original Chinese/Dangi protected-hook observations (23912 calendar hook rows total), preserving all prior23784 rows. Genuine public field writes exercise ordinal-month mapping, requested leap values0/1/2, checked era/year overflow and strict versus lenient extended-year bounds using Julian days inside the original global range.
